artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary between the hand/wrist and the leather glove is slightly soft and lacks the crisp definition of real leather stitching meeting skin/fabric. It looks slightly 'painted' rather than physically distinct.
The object held in the right hand (presumably a bat) merges ambiguously with the hip/pants area. The handle does not have a clear, rigid geometric structure and seems to blend into the uniform folds.
The background spectators are rendered as indistinct, melting blobs rather than distinct figures, which is common in AI generation but less realistic than optical bokeh.
